title: No Nether Water
description: Makes water related items evapourite from the player's inventory when entering the nether.
body:
# Water in the Nether is no more
## FEATURES:

When entering the nether:
- All potions, throwable potions, and lingering potions become empty bottles
- Prevents the player from having snow, ice, powdered snow and water buckets in the nether
- The regular water bucket becomes a bucket upon entering the nether
- A bucket with a fish inside will deposit that fish in the nether after being emptied
- All changes are made INSTANTLY upon entering the nether



Future features:
- Making ice and snow that's placed in the nether disappear
- Making water in cauldrons in the nether evaporate
